description: Ready-made trigger profiles used by tools_schedule.py --profile and as reference presets for generated projects.

profiles.label: Nightly batch
profiles.notes: Low-traffic window; catch up once after a missed run.

profiles.label: Weekday business hours
profiles.notes: Queue overlap so no window is dropped during busy days.

profiles.label: Hourly folder watch
profiles.notes: Event-driven watchers usually beat polling; use polling only when the watcher API is unavailable.

profiles.label: Monthly report
profiles.notes: First of month; verify month-end data is complete first.

profiles.label: One-time migration
profiles.notes: Never auto-retry a migration; require an operator to re-arm it.

profiles.label: Webhook trigger
profiles.notes: Verify the signature, bound the payload size, and deduplicate by delivery id.
